plain_description: **Build and deploy long-running AI agents that can keep their state and resume after failures.** Add human oversight and memory to workflows. Monitor agent behavior with LangSmith.
technical_description: LangGraph is a low-level orchestration framework for building, managing, and deploying long-running, stateful agents and workflows. It supports durable execution, human-in-the-loop state inspection and modification, and short- and long-term memory. It can be used standalone or with LangChain products.
title: LangGraph
